label: GitHub → Knowledge Base
description: Daily poll of a GitHub repo path. Reads everything under the supplied path and loads it into the Knowledge Base. Plain-text and markdown files are the common case; binary files in the path are still indexed via Tika.

inputs.name: repoOwner
inputs.label: Repository Owner
inputs.description: The GitHub user or org that owns the repo (e.g. bytechefhq).

inputs.name: path
inputs.label: Path
inputs.description: Path inside the repo to sync, e.g. 'docs' or 'README.md'. Empty string means the repo root.

ui.note: TODO: pick the Tika Document Reader cluster element after forking. The github/v1/getRepositoryContent action returns each file's decoded content as a string; either feed that directly to a string-document-reader, or fetch via a separate github API step if you need raw bytes.
